_status: TO BE VERIFIED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER. Starting values, not taken from any urban plan, standard or building code. How far a balcony may reach into a setback comes from the planning conditions of the plot.
_doc: width / depth / railing: starting size (metres) of a new balcony or loggia and the thickness of its railing. maxIntoSetback: how far (metres) a balcony may reach past the setback line towards the plot edge; 0 means it must stay behind the setback line like the building itself. door: width and height (metres) of the door a new balcony or loggia gets from the room behind it. Loggias lie inside the building outline and are checked with the building.
